guide.jj_giants.gloamwick.drops.10: @item gloamwick:gloamwick_codex |  | His book. Carry it and he never goes for you or hurts you, and he does what you tell him. "Come and carry me" lets you ride him and use his moves yourself.
guide.jj_giants.gloamwick.drops.12: @item gloamwick:gloamwick_finder |  | The Finder of the Gloamwick: how far he is and which way.
guide.jj_giants.gloamwick.commands.3: | /giants performance | how much of his effects and detail you see, and how far off: the Giants Performance screen (also /giants effects, a key, or the Performance button up top)
guide.jj_giants.gloamwick.commands.4: Players find him only with his Finder. Finding him by command needs cheats.
guide.jj_giants.gloamwick.commands.7: | /gloamwick summon [calm/hunting/guardian] [size] | makes one in front of you
guide.jj_giants.gloamwick.commands.8: | /gloamwick do <move> | the nearest one does that move (Tab lists them)
guide.jj_giants.gloamwick.commands.10: | /gloamwick come / goto <x> <z> / stay | calls him, sends him somewhere, or holds him still
guide.jj_giants.gloamwick.commands.11: | /gloamwick mood <mood> / size <size> | changes his mood or size
guide.jj_giants.gloamwick.commands.12: | /gloamwick sleep / wake / ride | puts him to sleep, wakes him, or puts you on him
guide.jj_giants.gloamwick.commands.13: | /gloamwick heal / hurt / health / kill / remove | what it says
guide.jj_giants.gloamwick.commands.14: | /gloamwick ground / ground new / ground at | where his Gloaming is, a new one, or whether you're in it
guide.jj_giants.gloamwick.commands.15: | /gloamwick snuff restore / snuff safe add | puts every light back, or keeps lights near you safe
guide.jj_giants.gloamwick.commands.16: | /gloamwick ward [on/off] | lights the Gloam Lantern set down near you, or puts it out
guide.jj_giants.gloamwick.commands.17: | /gloamwick limit [number] / away on/off | how many of him at most, and stepping out with nobody near
guide.jj_giants.gloamwick.commands.18: | /gloamwick heavydelay [seconds] | how long into a fight before his first heavy move (60 to start with)
guide.jj_giants.gloamwick.commands.19: | /gloamwick meetings on/off | whether he fights or keeps away from the giants he meets
guide.jj_giants.gloamwick.commands.20: | /gloamwick powers reset | the Wickbark's powers and the Antler are ready again
guide.jj_giants.gloamwick.move.antler_ho: He hooks with his antlers at what is in front of him.
guide.jj_giants.gloamwick.move.antler_to: He scoops and tosses with his antlers.
guide.jj_giants.gloamwick.move.hoof_stam: He stamps a front hoof down. A ring of soul fire round it.
guide.jj_giants.gloamwick.move.rear_and_: He kicks out behind him with both back legs.
guide.jj_giants.gloamwick.move.head_slam: He slams his head down on a spot in front of him.
guide.jj_giants.gloamwick.move.ember_fli: He flicks three embers from his antlers.
guide.jj_giants.gloamwick.move.snort.wha: He snorts dark mist in front of him. Darkness for whoever is in it.
guide.jj_giants.gloamwick.move.wick_lash: He lashes blue fire from his antlers.
guide.jj_giants.gloamwick.move.gloam_bre: He breathes dark mist in a long cone.
guide.jj_giants.gloamwick.move.snuff_wav: A wave rolls out from him and puts out lights.
guide.jj_giants.gloamwick.move.shadow_st: He steps through the shadows and comes out behind what he's after.
guide.jj_giants.gloamwick.move.antler_sw: He sweeps his antlers round in a wide circle.
guide.jj_giants.gloamwick.move.soul_chai: Soul chains rise and hold what he's after.
guide.jj_giants.gloamwick.move.wandering: He lets lost souls loose to hunt.
He spits hot wax that leaves pools.
guide.jj_giants.gloamwick.move.grave_tol: He tolls three times. Each toll is a ring.
guide.jj_giants.gloamwick.move.ghost_lun: A ghost of him lunges ahead of him.
guide.jj_giants.gloamwick.move.candle_vo: He lobs a volley of candles.
guide.jj_giants.gloamwick.move.antler_fl: His antlers flare up and burn round him.
guide.jj_giants.gloamwick.move.candlefal: Hot wax rains down. Each drop shows its shadow first.
guide.jj_giants.gloamwick.move.night_bel: He bellows into the night. The dark closes in.
guide.jj_giants.gloamwick.move.soul_harv: He pulls the souls out of everything round him.
guide.jj_giants.gloamwick.move.lantern_r: Three beams of light turn round him.
guide.jj_giants.gloamwick.move.stampede_: A stampede of his shades runs across the ground.
guide.jj_giants.gloamwick.move.rearing_c: He rears up and crashes down.
guide.jj_giants.gloamwick.move.soul_pyre: Pyres of soul fire rise where he marks.
guide.jj_giants.gloamwick.move.eclipse.w: The sky goes black for 20 seconds and the Hush, his shadow got up, hunts you. It always knows where you are.
perf.jj_giants.s.fx.particles.name: Particles
perf.jj_giants.s.fx.particles.what: How many particles the giants give off: dust, sparks, spores, embers, drips.
perf.jj_giants.s.fx.particles.loses: Fewer particles round every giant and every move.
perf.jj_giants.s.fx.bigImpacts.name: Big impacts
perf.jj_giants.s.fx.bigImpacts.what: Chunks of ground, debris and cracks thrown up when a big blow lands.
perf.jj_giants.s.fx.bigImpacts.loses: Big blows throw up less, down to nothing at 0%%.
perf.jj_giants.s.fx.smokeTrails.name: Smoke and trails
perf.jj_giants.s.fx.smokeTrails.what: Smoke plumes, swipe trails and the trails behind thrown things.
perf.jj_giants.s.fx.flashes.name: Flashes and glow
perf.jj_giants.s.fx.flashes.what: Bright flashes, glowing parts and the light the giants and their moves give off.
perf.jj_giants.s.fx.flashes.loses: Dimmer flashes and fewer moving lights.
perf.jj_giants.s.fx.screenShake.name: Screen shake
perf.jj_giants.s.fx.screenShake.what: How much your view shakes from footsteps and big blows.
perf.jj_giants.s.fx.screenShake.loses: Less shake, so you feel the hits less.
perf.jj_giants.s.fx.screenEffects.name: Screen effects
perf.jj_giants.s.fx.screenEffects.what: Dark edges, sky darkening and colour washes on your screen near a giant.
perf.jj_giants.s.fx.screenEffects.loses: Softer screen effects; some warnings are harder to notice.
perf.jj_giants.s.fx.ambient.name: Biome ambient particles
perf.jj_giants.s.fx.ambient.what: What drifts in the air of the giants' own grounds: spores, ash, motes, leaves.
perf.jj_giants.s.fx.ambient.loses: Emptier air in the giants' grounds; at 0%% none.
perf.jj_giants.s.fx.fog.name: Biome fog
perf.jj_giants.s.fx.fog.what: The fog of the giants' grounds and the fog that closes in round a giant.
perf.jj_giants.s.fx.fog.loses: No giant fog: you see further but lose the mood.
perf.jj_giants.s.detail.model.name: Model detail at distance
perf.jj_giants.s.detail.model.what: How far off a giant is still drawn in full before a simpler model takes over.
perf.jj_giants.s.detail.model.loses: The simpler model starts closer, so far giants look blockier.
perf.jj_giants.s.detail.animation.name: Animation detail
perf.jj_giants.s.detail.animation.what: Small moving parts: tentacles, strands, cloth, eyes, wobble.
perf.jj_giants.s.detail.animation.loses: Small parts move less, first far off, then near too.
perf.jj_giants.s.detail.farSight.name: Far-sight skyline giants
perf.jj_giants.s.detail.farSight.what: Giants seen on the skyline from far away, before they are really loaded.
perf.jj_giants.s.detail.farSight.loses: You only see a giant once he is near.
perf.jj_giants.s.detail.farSightDistance: How far off skyline giants show, times each giant's own setting.
Skyline giants show from closer only.
perf.jj_giants.s.detail.lootBeams.name: Loot beams
perf.jj_giants.s.detail.lootBeams.what: The beams of light over loot caches, near and far.
perf.jj_giants.s.detail.lootBeams.loses: Near only drops the far beams; Off drops them all.
perf.jj_giants.s.detail.sounds.name: Giant sounds volume
perf.jj_giants.s.detail.sounds.what: How loud the giants' sounds are, times each giant's own volume.
perf.jj_giants.s.detail.sounds.loses: Quieter giants (this doesn't make anything faster).
perf.jj_giants.s.detail.music.name: Fight music volume
perf.jj_giants.s.detail.music.what: How loud the giants' fight music is.
perf.jj_giants.s.detail.renderDistance.w: How far off he is still drawn, times his own setting.
perf.jj_giants.s.detail.renderDistance.l: He disappears sooner as you walk away.
perf.jj_giants.s.feature.meetings.name: Giant-vs-giant meetings
perf.jj_giants.s.feature.meetings.what: Giants notice each other as they wander, and fight or keep away.
perf.jj_giants.s.feature.meetings.loses: Giants ignore each other: no giant-vs-giant fights at all.
perf.jj_giants.s.feature.summons.name: Summon counts
perf.jj_giants.s.feature.summons.what: How many helpers summoning moves call: robots, crew, shades, little ones.
perf.jj_giants.s.feature.summons.loses: Fewer helpers come; those moves are weaker and the fight is easier.
perf.jj_giants.s.feature.keepAwake.name: Keep-awake range
perf.jj_giants.s.feature.keepAwake.what: How far the ground round a giant is kept loaded while someone can see him.
perf.jj_giants.s.feature.keepAwake.loses: Under 100%% a far giant can freeze mid-move; at 0%% he stops whenever his middle chunk unloads.
perf.jj_giants.s.feature.footPrecision.w: How often the server works out where each foot lands.
perf.jj_giants.s.feature.footPrecision.l: Feet can sink or float a moment on rough ground, and stomps land a tick or two late.
perf.jj_giants.s.feature.hitSampling.wha: How many points along limbs and bodies are checked for hits.
perf.jj_giants.s.feature.hitSampling.los: Gaps open where a limb can pass through you, or your hit through him, without counting.
perf.jj_giants.s.feature.landmarks.name: Landmark density (new chunks)
perf.jj_giants.s.feature.landmarks.what: How many ruins, shrines and marks are built in new chunks of the giants' grounds.
perf.jj_giants.s.feature.landmarks.loses: New land gets fewer landmarks. Land already made stays as it is.
perf.jj_giants.title: Giants Performance
perf.jj_giants.open.tip: Turn the giants' effects and detail up or down (/giants performance)
perf.jj_giants.preset.tip: Click for the next preset (◀ and ▶ go either way). Each says what it turns down.
perf.jj_giants.with_features.tip: Operators: when on, picking a preset also sets the world's features to that preset's. Off, presets only change your own settings.
perf.jj_giants.features.op: Saved with this world and used for every player. Each one says what it takes away.
perf.jj_giants.features.not_op: Ask an operator: only operators (or the owner of a single-player world) can change these.
perf.jj_giants.features.no_server: This server doesn't have the Giants Guide, so its features can't be changed from here.
perf.jj_giants.read_by.none: No installed giant reads this yet (it needs a newer giant mod).
perf.jj_giants.highest: Highest: every effect, detail and feature exactly as the giants are made. Nothing is changed.
perf.jj_giants.same: %s: the same as Highest. Nothing is changed.
perf.jj_giants.custom: Custom: your own mix, started from %s.
perf.jj_giants.left_out: Not listed (their mods are older than this screen): %s
